name: Interior Design
description: Designing the inside of buildings — space planning, materials, lighting, furniture, finishes and the codes that govern all of it. ⚠⚠⚠ The fact that decides which programme you need: in Florida, ALL RESIDENTIAL interior design work is exempt from registration by statute. Registration exists for NONRESIDENTIAL work, and it runs through a national exam with a 60-credit education floor.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠⚠ THE LEVEL OF THE CREDENTIAL IS WORTH A YEAR OF YOUR LIFE, AND ALMOST NOBODY SAYS SO. To sit the NCIDQ exam — the gate to Florida registration — a bachelor's or master's in interior design needs 3,520 supervised work hours (two years full time). ⚠⚠ An ASSOCIATE DEGREE, CERTIFICATE OR DIPLOMA needs 5,280 (THREE years), for the same exam. ⚠ And Florida's output is overwhelmingly the second kind: of 341 credentials in Interior Design (50.0408), only 94 are bachelor's and 9 master's — 132 are short certificates and 97 associate degrees. ⚠⚠⚠ SO ROUGHLY SEVEN IN TEN FLORIDA INTERIOR DESIGN CREDENTIALS PUT THE HOLDER ON THE THREE-YEAR ROUTE. ⚠ FOUR PUBLIC PROGRAMMES ARE CIDA-ACCREDITED: University of Florida (Bachelor of Design, accredited since 1974), Florida State (B.S.), Seminole State College (B.A.S. — the only CIDA-accredited STATE COLLEGE in Florida), and Florida International (Master of Interior Architecture). ⚠⚠ CIDA accreditation does NOT shorten the work requirement — a non-CIDA bachelor's also sits at 3,520 hours. What it does is SATISFY the 60-credit interior design requirement automatically, so you never have to document it course by course. ⚠⚠⚠ AND THE DATA HIDES ONE OF THE FOUR: FIU awards NOTHING under 50.0408, because its CIDA-accredited Master of Interior Architecture is filed in the ARCHITECTURE family (04.09) instead. A school list built from the interior design code alone would omit it. ⚠ An NAAB architecture degree is also an NCIDQ route, at 5,280 hours.

cips.note: Interior Design — 9 Florida public institutions and 341 credentials: 132 certificates of twelve weeks to a year, 97 associate, 94 bachelor's, 9 master's, 9 longer certificates. Seminole State College 187 (the largest by far), FSCJ 43, Florida State 37, Palm Beach State 26, UF 21, Miami Dade 8, Pinellas Technical 8, Daytona State 5, Indian River State 6. ⚠⚠ Note the shape: certificates and associate degrees outnumber bachelor's by more than two to one.

related.note: ⚠⚠⚠ Two hard connections, not a resemblance. Florida regulates both in the SAME statute — chapter 481 Part I, one Board of Architecture and Interior Design — and s. 481.229(5)(a) lets a registered ARCHITECT perform interior design and use the title without separate registration. ⚠ An NAAB-accredited architecture degree is also an NCIDQ education route, at 5,280 work hours against an interior design degree's 3,520.

⚠⚠ Named because a registered interior designer's seal STOPS at a line the construction team has to cross: s. 481.2131 excludes structural, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, electrical and vertical-transport systems, and every life-safety element. ⚠ Knowing who signs for what is most of coordinating a fit-out, and construction management is 30 Florida institutions against interior design's 9.

⚠ The neighbour students most often confuse this with, and the federal projections differ sharply: BLS names AI as expected to REDUCE the need for graphic designers (−2%) and makes NO AI claim at all about interior designers (+3%). ⚠⚠ A drawing can be generated; a code-compliant occupied room cannot.

⚠ Named for the practical reason: BLS says most interior designers use CAD for most of their drawings, and Revit and AutoCAD are what a Florida interior design office actually runs. ⚠⚠ Drafting is also the commonest way to earn NCIDQ work hours while finishing the credential — but check that the hours are supervised and recorded as interior design work.
